Class XYPlotBuilder

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.plot.XYPlotBuilder
public final class XYPlotBuilder extends Object
Fluent construction of ordinary MDI XY plots.

The builder is deliberately a convenience layer, not a second plotting model. build() creates the same PlotData, Curve, PlotCanvas, and PlotPanel objects that an application would create directly. The resulting panel can therefore be placed in a PlotDeck, and callers retain access to every existing sPlot API.

Input arrays are defensively copied when a series is registered. A builder may be reused; each build creates a fresh plot model and fresh curves. Series style customizers receive the native ACurve, while plot customizers receive the native PlotParameters. This keeps uncommon or future MDI options accessible without continually expanding the builder.

Threading

Build plots on Swing's event-dispatch thread when they will immediately become part of a visible UI. The returned curves retain their normal thread-safe data-appending behavior.

    • series

      public XYPlotBuilder series(String name, double[] x, double[] y, Consumer<ACurve> customizer)
      Adds an XY series with a native MDI curve customizer.

      The customizer runs during each build after the copied data have been installed and before the canvas is returned. Typical customizations set line color, symbol, width, or drawing method.

      Parameters:
      name - legend name
      x - x coordinates
      y - y coordinates
      customizer - curve style/drawing customizer
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if array lengths differ
